content.short: Entangle is an omnichain data and liquidity layer on Mantle that unifies cross-chain state, messaging, and automation for DeFi protocols.
content.description: Entangle is an omnichain infrastructure protocol that provides a unified layer for cross-chain data availability, liquidity routing, and smart contract automation. Its Photon Messaging Layer enables secure bidirectional communication between blockchains, while the Universal Data Feeds deliver real-time cross-chain data to smart contracts. Entangle's agent network automates complex cross-chain DeFi workflows, making it a foundational piece of infrastructure for multi-chain applications deployed on Mantle and beyond.
content.meta: Entangle is an omnichain data and messaging infrastructure layer powering cross-chain DeFi on Mantle. Discover Entangle on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
